name: El Dorado International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways, 14L/32R and 14R/32L, each 3,800 m x 45 m asphalt

hours.v: airport, ATS, fuel and security H24

slots.v: all operations to be coordinated in good time with the slot office
slots.quote: users are called upon to coordinate with enough time all their operations with the slot office.

handling.v: general aviation, non-scheduled and charter flights must contract a handling company
handling.quote: must contract a Handling service company for airport stopover.

max_aircraft.v: piston aircraft and training flights not permitted; fixed-wing VFR arrivals prohibited
max_aircraft.quote: The operation of piston aircraft is prohibited.

noise.v: night runway-use scheme (times as printed, normally UTC: 0500-1159 = 00:00-06:59 local): set arrival/departure runways between 0500 and 1159, unrestricted 1200-0459 on 14L/32R; aircraft of noise QC 4 or more may not take off from 14L
noise.quote: Between 0500 and 0959, arrivals using Runway 14L and departures using Runway 32R

notes: Read: Colombia AIP AD 2 SKBO - Bogotá - El Dorado, Aerocivil, folder 'AIP AMDT VIGENTE', pages dated 28 NOV 2024, AIRAC AMDT 67/24. Only the first 100,000 of about 500,000 characters (AD 2.1-2.20 and part of AD 2.20 runway use) were read; AD 2.21 not reached. Runway-use times are printed without a zone; AIP times are normally UTC (Bogotá UTC-5) - confirm. No curfew stated in the part read. The QC 4 restriction quote: 'are not allowed to take off using Runway 14L'. IATA code not stated.
